bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}}' | grep -Ei 'postgres' | head -n 15 || true
found=0
for cid in $(docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}}' | awk 'tolower($0) ~ /postgres/ {print $1}'); do
 echo "DB_CANDIDATE=$cid"
 docker exec "$cid" sh -c 'PGPASSWORD="${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-}" psql -X -q -U "${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres}" -d "${POSTGRES_DB:-postgres}" -At -c "SELECT to_regclass('\''public.posting_topics'\'') IS NOT NULL" 2>/dev/null' | grep -x t >/dev/null || continue
 echo "GATE_TOPIC_DATABASE=$cid"
 docker exec "$cid" sh -c 'PGPASSWORD="${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-}" psql -X -q -U "${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres}" -d "${POSTGRES_DB:-postgres}" -At -F "|" -c "SELECT board_key,purpose,chat_id,message_thread_id,title,enabled,verified_at IS NOT NULL,verified_by IS NOT NULL FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='\''video_sale'\'' ORDER BY topic_id LIMIT 10"'
 found=1
done
echo "GATE_DB_FOUND=$found"
